newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key 182nd 10-yr JGB yield sets record closing low.
newsitem.headline: Key 182nd 10-yr JGB yield sets record closing low.

text.p: The benchmark 182nd 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) yield set a record closing low of 2.240 percent on Thursday, said Japan Bond Trading Co, Japan's largest inter-dealer broker.
The yield hit an intra-day record low of 2.235 percent in late afternoon. It had closed at 2.300 percent on Wednesday.
Buying by some life insurers was detected in long-term JGBs in early trade and this encouraged many dealers to follow suit, traders said.

JGB purchases this week have been partly attributed to some operators' efforts to window-dress their books for the end of the financial year on March 31, they said. JGBs to be traded on and after March 21 are settled in the new year.

Some traders said firmness in late trade was due to news that comprehensive measures to raise the liquidity of the property market were unlikely to be included in the government deregulation package due to be announced later this month.

The debt market has been worried about possible moves by the government to pep up the property market, as revitalised land transactions would raise the prospect of a healthy economic recovery, giving the central bank leeway to tighten its credit grip. -- Tokyo Treasury Desk +81-33432-8570
